Display Name: U. Michigan Expected Business Conditions (% expecting better)
Description: University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers, expected change in business conditions a year ahead: share of respondents expecting better conditions (Data Master column 1; not the balance/relative score, not a diffusion index, not the headline Consumer Sentiment index)
Series ID: UMICH_EXP_BUS_COND (Data Master; not on FRED/ALFRED). Release timing: FRED UMCSENT release dates (same survey release)
Unit: % of respondents expecting better business conditions
Direction Convention: Higher = more respondents expect better business conditions
Known Quirks: No public archive of past values: only today's values exist, so earlier months may differ from first publication (unquantified). Published in the Michigan survey release (preliminary mid-month, final at or before the end of the survey month). Data Master series ends 2025-09
Display Note: Rising expected business conditions are read as a sign of stronger spending ahead.
Used as the equity-market target and benchmark.
